name: content-lifecycle-ext
description: The content layer's half of the content lifecycle: the operational planning, authoring, publication and retirement skills (moved up from cat-harness's content-lifecycle, content split step 1; the harness keeps the review, validation, test and feedback methods its own processes call), quality control across a folio's QA checks (placement PR1, #1702), reviewer comments on a folio's edit-set (moved down from cat-harness, bean lthi), the content block change summary for a delivery (split from delivery-summary, placement PR2, bean pzwb), and the contracts two lower roles are held to in this layer's diagrams: the corpus when an accepted edit is committed, and an external registry when a source's authority is checked.
